response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, including some Java and DLang work, but lacks clear, recent, deep expertise in JVM tooling, Spring, or enterprise IDE development — his recent roles focus on TypeScript, Node.js, and AI-agent tooling, with only historical Java exposure in non-IDE contexts.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and tooling passion (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Proven ability to learn and deliver complex systems in diverse environments
concerns: No recent or demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate in enterprise contexts
Primary recent tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js, not JVM-based IDE tooling
Lack of explicit work on IDE internals, language servers, or build tool integrations
